P02.noneLine: [EN] A shared space only opens from a disruption, already carrying its playbook and standing commitments. When your team is activated, the message links straight here.

P03.title: [EN] Post a statement
P03.typeHint: [EN] Pick one. Each kind feeds the coverage view in its own way.

lines.doing: [EN] Something your organisation is doing now.
lines.canTake: [EN] Something you can take on. Others can count on it.
lines.cannotCover: [EN] Something you cannot do, so nobody counts on it. It shows as a gap.
lines.need: [EN] Something you need from another organisation. It shows as a gap until someone takes it on.

placeholder.doing: [EN] For example: Community room open for charging until 9 pm.
placeholder.canTake: [EN] For example: We can bring 40 power banks from our depot.
placeholder.cannotCover: [EN] For example: We cannot provide overnight shelter tonight.
placeholder.need: [EN] For example: Power banks for residents who cannot come down.

P03.textHint: [EN] Plain words. Never name a resident.
P03.supplyHint: [EN] From Supplies. On the coverage view, a need and an item that could meet it are shown together.
P03.answersTitle: [EN] Is it an answer to a need already posted?
P03.noAnswer: [EN] No, it stands on its own
P03.preview: [EN] How it appears in the space
P03.pickFirst: [EN] Choose a kind of statement and write one line first.
P03.postedLine: [EN] Everyone in the space sees it now, with your organisation and your name. The coverage view has already picked it up.
P03.toCoverage: [EN] See it on the coverage view

purposes.shelter: [EN] Find people a safe place to stay
purposes.welfare: [EN] Look after people who cannot leave, week by week
purposes.recovery: [EN] Help people recover after the disruption

P04.orgsTitle: [EN] Organisations in this space, with the capacity each one set
P04.assembled: [EN] Assembled from {st} statements, {cm} standing commitments and the {hazard} playbook. Nobody edits this view. It changes when someone posts, takes something on or confirms.

groupLines.gap: [EN] Nobody has this yet. Take one on and it moves for everyone.
groupLines.working: [EN] Someone has said they will do it.
groupLines.waiting: [EN] Offered, committed or asked, and waiting on someone to say yes, confirm or take it.

emptyGroup.working: [EN] Nothing is being worked on yet.
emptyGroup.covered: [EN] Nobody has said they are doing anything yet.

P04.tPlaybookOnly: [EN] From the {hazard} playbook, version {v}. Nobody has said they are taking this.
P04.tPlaybookProposed: [EN] From the proposed {hazard} playbook (not yet agreed).
P04.tChecklistAlert: [EN] Done through the alert to residents: {headline}
P04.tChecklistHandover: [EN] Done through {n} handover notes in this space
P04.tHandoverOpen: [EN] Named as open in {name}'s handover note, {t}
P04.tCommitmentNone: [EN] From standing commitments: nobody has agreed to cover {hazard} in advance.
P04.stateAnswered: [EN] {org} said they can take this on
P04.stateOffer: [EN] Offered by {org}. Waiting on someone to say yes.
P04.stateUnconfirmed: [EN] Committed but not yet confirmed for this disruption. Waiting on {org} to confirm.
P04.stateDeclined: [EN] Declined for this disruption by {org}. Nobody else has it.
P04.stateReleased: [EN] Released at handover. Waiting on someone to take it.
P04.stateAsk: [EN] Asked of {org} by the playbook. Waiting on {org} to say they have it.
P04.stateChecklist: [EN] On the playbook checklist. Nobody has said they are doing it.
P04.stateNoCommitment: [EN] No organisation has a standing commitment for this kind of disruption. It is a decision to be made.
P04.claimToast: [EN] Taken on by {org}. Everyone in this space now sees it under "Being worked on".
P04.claimExercise: [EN] Taken on by {org}, as practice. Nothing reached residents.
P04.ownGap: [EN] Posted by your organisation. Another organisation can take it on here.
P04.confirmToast: [EN] Confirmed. It now shows as covered.
P04.matchTitle: [EN] A supply item that could meet it
P04.spacesTitle: [EN] Spaces and how full they are
P04.spacesLine: [EN] Status as residents see it. Each organisation sets its own on Our spaces.
P04.spaceCapMax: [EN] Takes up to {max} people. Nobody has said how many are there now.
P04.ambLine: [EN] Floors with and without a floor ambassador, and check-in round progress as counts. No resident can be identified from this.
P04.noAmb: [EN] No ambassador named. No check-ins happen here.
P04.noRound: [EN] No check-in round runs for this disruption.
P04.exercise: [EN] Exercise: anything taken on here is practice. Nothing reaches residents.
P04.noSpaceLine: [EN] A shared space opens from a disruption on Incidents. It arrives with the playbook and the standing commitments already in it.

lines.stretched: [EN] We are managing, but cannot take on much more.
lines.atCapacity: [EN] We cannot take on anything new.
lines.notSet: [EN] Say nothing about our capacity for now.

P05.title: [EN] Our capacity right now
P05.lead: [EN] One tap. It shows beside {org} everywhere in the shared space, on every statement and on the coverage view.
P05.notSetLine: [EN] Nobody from {org} has set it. Partners see "Not set".
P05.selfDeclared: [EN] Self-declared. Only your organisation can set this. Nobody else can set it for you, and nothing calculates it.
P05.setTo: [EN] Capacity set to {word}. Everyone in the space sees it beside your name now.
P05.cleared: [EN] Capacity cleared. Partners now see "Not set".
P05.exerciseSet: [EN] Capacity set to {word} for this exercise.
P05.preview: [EN] How it appears beside your name
P05.othersLine: [EN] Each organisation sets its own. You cannot change theirs.
P05.toCoverage: [EN] See it on the coverage view

P06.title: [EN] The activation, as staff receive it
P06.lead: [EN] Sent directly to the designated staff of each organisation, by text message and by email, from the same sender as resident alerts.
P06.specimen: [EN] Specimen. A sample message: nothing is sent from the prototype.
P06.askDefault: [EN] join the space and say what you can take on.
P06.length: [EN] {n} characters: fits in one text message.
P06.foot: [EN] You get this because {org} named your role for {plural} at level {n} in Teams and triggers. It came to you directly, not through a manager.
P06.orderTitle: [EN] What it carries, in this order
P06.why: [EN] Nobody forwards it. Nothing is sent until a person confirms activation on Official alert received, or opens the shared space for the disruption.
P06.exNote: [EN] Exercise: the first line of every message says so, in every launch language.
P06.notOpenYet: [EN] The space opens from the disruption first. This link lands in it once it is open.
P06.toP01: [EN] Open the space for this alert

P07.title: [EN] Spaces {org} runs
P07.lead: [EN] Open, full or closed in one tap. The change reaches the resident listing and the alert at the same moment.
P07.onlyOwn: [EN] Only spaces run by {org} are here. Every other organisation sets its own.
P07.none: [EN] {org} does not run a space that residents can go to. If that changes, the Hub adds it to the map and it appears here.
P07.confirmsToo: [EN] Setting a state also confirms these as they stand today:
P07.changeFactsNote: [EN] Editing hours and facilities is not part of this prototype. Setting a state confirms them as they stand.
P07.capAtMax: [EN] At its limit. Set it to Full so residents are not sent here.
P07.staleLine: [EN] Residents now see "Not confirmed" and are told to call before they go.
P07.dueLine: [EN] After {limit} without a confirmation, residents see "Not confirmed".
P07.residentsLine: [EN] On the listing (R-12) and in the open-near-you part of the alert (R-07). Same record, same moment.
P07.residentsExercise: [EN] Residents still see this. Nothing in this exercise reached them.
P07.practiceLine: [EN] Exercise. This change stays in the exercise.
P07.set: [EN] Set to {status}. Residents see it on the listing and in the alert now.
P07.setExercise: [EN] Practice: set to {status}. Nothing reached residents.
P07.confirmed: [EN] Confirmed as still correct. Residents see "Confirmed just now".
P07.capSet: [EN] {now} of {max} people. Shown to partners on Supplies and Coverage.
P07.toCoverage: [EN] See all spaces on the coverage view

P08.title: [EN] What each organisation holds
P08.lead: [EN] What each organisation holds, where, and roughly how much. One tap keeps it current.
P08.partnerOnly: [EN] Partners only. Residents never see this list, and nothing here has a route from the resident app.
P08.noSpaceHere: [EN] No space for residents at this site

P09.title: [EN] Decisions for {what}
P09.lead: [EN] Newest first. Each one says who decided, when, why and what it came from. Separate from the conversation.
P09.kept: [EN] This log is kept with the disruption's record when the shared space closes.
P09.fromNone: [EN] Nothing in the space: decided in a call or a meeting
P09.recorded: [EN] Recorded. It is at the top of the log for everyone in the space.
P09.recordedExercise: [EN] Recorded as practice. It stays with the exercise record.
P09.fromDirect: [EN] Recorded directly, not from a message or statement
P09.emptyLine: [EN] When partners agree something, record it here or from any message or statement in the shared space. It takes one line of why.
P09.exercise: [EN] Exercise: decisions recorded now are practice.

P10.title: [EN] Hand over before you leave
P10.lead: [EN] What {org} holds in this space is already listed. Confirm where each one goes and write one line. Nothing is left without an owner.
P10.toHint: [EN] They get the note and the items you hand to them.
P10.heldNone: [EN] {org} holds nothing in this space. Write one line for whoever comes next and you are done.
P10.commitment: [EN] Standing commitment, confirmed for this disruption
P10.stays: [EN] Stays with {org}. {name} holds it from now.
P10.moves: [EN] Moves to {org}. It shows as taken on by them.
P10.released: [EN] Released. It shows on the coverage view as waiting on someone.
P10.undecided: [EN] Not decided yet: hand it on or release it.
P10.openLine: [EN] Nobody has taken these on. They go into the handover as open items.
P10.noteLabel: [EN] One line for the next person
P10.noteHint: [EN] Plain words. Never name a resident.
P10.leftN: [EN] Decide {n} more before you can hand over.
P10.leftOne: [EN] Decide 1 more before you can hand over.
P10.needNote: [EN] Write one line for the next person.
P10.prevNone: [EN] Nobody handed this space to you. You joined it directly.
P10.whatTitle: [EN] What happens when you hand over
what: [EN] The note goes to the top of the shared space, and to {to}.
[EN] Items you hand on keep an owner.
[EN] Released items show on the coverage view as waiting on someone, never as covered.
P10.doneLine: [EN] It is at the top of the shared space for {to}. You can leave.

P11.title: [EN] Standing commitments
P11.lead: [EN] What each organisation has agreed to do, by disruption type and by mode. Each one names a role, not a person, and points to the agreement it comes from.
P11.overdueLead: [EN] Oldest first. If it still holds, confirm it in one tap. The next review moves six months on.
P11.overdueNone: [EN] No reviews overdue. The next one is due {date}.
P11.changeNote: [EN] Changing a commitment is agreed with the organisation at the next review. Editing is not in this prototype.
P11.confirmedToast: [EN] Confirmed as still correct. Next review {date}.
P11.confirmed: [EN] Confirmed as still correct {when} by {name}. Next review {date}.
P11.tableLead: [EN] The same six disruptions residents plan for on Be ready.
P11.docNote: [EN] The agreement stays with the organisation that holds it. Opening documents is not in this prototype.
P11.gapLine: [EN] No organisation has committed to anything for this disruption. This is a decision for the partners to make, not an error.
P11.gapQuestion: [EN] To decide: which organisation, if any, takes this on, and in which mode?
P11.gapContext: [EN] A playbook was proposed during the Sample Tower B repairs. It is not yet agreed.
P11.gapOnAgenda: [EN] On the agenda for the review on {date}.
P11.gapAgendaToast: [EN] Added to the agenda for the partner review.
P11.nextLine: [EN] All commitments, playbooks and triggers are reviewed together on {date}.

P12.title: [EN] Playbooks
P12.lead: [EN] One playbook for each of the six disruptions residents plan for on Be ready. Opening a shared space loads the playbook for its disruption.
P12.proposedLine: [EN] Proposed during the Sample Tower B repairs, not yet agreed. Until partners agree it, this playbook is still a placeholder and a shared space for this disruption loads nothing from it.
P12.placeholderLine: [EN] Not drafted yet. It will set out the same four parts as the power outage playbook: who is activated, which spaces open, which templates are used, and what is asked of each partner.
P12.placeholderNext: [EN] To be drafted with partners at the review on {date}.
P12.settingsTitle: [EN] Set by this playbook, for every alert of this type
P12.staleTitle: [EN] Flagged as stale after {t} without an update
P12.staleLine: [EN] The incident is flagged as stale on Incidents when an alert of this type goes this long without an update.
P12.postDirectLine: [EN] A floor ambassador's post of this type goes out on every channel at once. Residents see "Not yet verified" until the Hub checks it.
P12.postHub: [EN] Ambassador posts wait for the Hub
P12.postHubLine: [EN] A floor ambassador's post of this type is held until the Hub approves it. Nothing goes out before that.
P12.postNone: [EN] Ambassadors do not post this type
P12.postNoneLine: [EN] It comes from the Hub for the whole neighbourhood, not from one building.
P12.partsTitleProposed: [EN] Day one, in four parts, as proposed
P12.partsLead: [EN] Each part is set somewhere else. The link takes you there.
P12.p4: [EN] What is asked of each partner
P12.checklistLead: [EN] These become coverage items in the shared space until someone takes them on.
P12.adjustNote: [EN] A shared space can adjust its copy for that disruption. The agreed version here does not change.

P13.title: [EN] Teams and triggers
P13.lead: [EN] Who is activated for each disruption and level, how they are reached, and the event that starts it. Each team is a role, not a person.
P13.how1: [EN] A matching event does not activate anyone by itself. A Hub staff member confirms first.
P13.how2: [EN] The team hears directly, by text message and email, from the same sender as resident alerts. It does not go through a manager.
P13.how3: [EN] Triggers are reviewed after every disruption and every exercise.
P13.seeOfficial: [EN] See an official alert that matches a trigger
P13.gapLine: [EN] Nobody is activated at this level. This is a decision to make, not an error.
P13.gapQuestion: [EN] To decide: who is activated when an elevator outage runs for more than a few days?

P14.title: [EN] Exercises
P14.lead: [EN] Practise the whole flow with the people who would do it for real. An exercise starts from a practice disruption, and nothing reaches residents.
P14.levelGap: [EN] No team is designated at this level. The exercise will show the gap.
P14.you: [EN] You run this exercise, so you are in it already.
P14.enrolledOnly: [EN] Only the people you enrol see it. Everyone else carries on as normal.
P14.summaryNone: [EN] Enrol at least one person to start.
P14.startedToast: [EN] Exercise started. Everyone enrolled now sees the exercise marker.
P14.firstNote: [EN] Starting creates a practice disruption first: {what}. The shared space and everything else open from it, never from nothing.
P14.safeLine: [EN] No text message, app alert or space status change goes out while this runs. Reach is shown for practice only. Every screen and message in the exercise carries the word Exercise.
P14.staffSees: [EN] Sees the exercise marker on every screen.
P14.ambSees: [EN] Gets a practice check-in round on his phone, marked as an exercise.
P14.nextLead: [EN] The normal screens, in the usual order. Each one shows the exercise marker.
P14.sAckDone: [EN] Practice acknowledgement published. Nothing reached residents.
P14.sSpace: [EN] Open the shared space for this exercise
P14.sSpaceNot: [EN] Not open yet. It opens from the practice disruption, with the playbook loaded.
P14.sNoticeLine: [EN] What the enrolled teams receive by text message and email, marked as an exercise.
P14.sCoverageLine: [EN] Commitments and checklist items, and the gaps nobody has taken.
P14.sRoundLine: [EN] On the enrolled ambassador's phone (A-04), in the resident app.
P14.endLine: [EN] Ending takes everyone out of exercise mode and names the record it produces.
P14.endedToast: [EN] Exercise ended. The record is named below.
P14.recordLine: [EN] It becomes a past record in Look back, labelled as an exercise, so the debrief works from real timings. Exercise figures are never counted as real.
P14.recordStatic: [EN] Static in this prototype: Look back shows a sample exercise record as the evidence.
P14.toLookBack: [EN] Open the record in Look back
P14.schedLead: [EN] Set the next one now so it happens. Repeating exercises keep the flow familiar.
P14.schedSaved: [EN] Scheduled. It repeats until someone changes it.
P14.schedNote: [EN] Illustrative: nothing is booked or sent from this prototype.

P15.title: [EN] Indicators
P15.lead: [EN] Is the CVH reaching people and being kept current? Counts and rates only.
P15.exportToast: [EN] Illustrative: a CSV of these aggregate figures and their definitions would download now. It holds no resident-level data.
P15.exportedLine: [EN] Exported {t} as a CSV of aggregate figures and definitions (illustrative). No resident-level data was included.
P15.agreed: [EN] Definitions agreed on {date} with partners and the Community Experts Board.
P15.privacy: [EN] No resident can be identified from these figures. Numbers under 5 are shown as "Fewer than 5".
rules: [EN] Counts and rates only. Names, phone numbers, addresses, units and floors are never counted here.
[EN] Any figure from 1 to 4 is shown as "Fewer than 5", in every split and every export.
[EN] Real disruptions, exercises and everyday use are counted separately and never added together.
[EN] Trust and usefulness are asked in a survey, not worked out from what people click.
[EN] The definitions are reviewed with the indicators at each quarterly review. The next one is on {review}.
P15.colRealLine: [EN] Alerts and rounds in a real disruption.
P15.colExerciseLine: [EN] Practice only. Never added to real figures.
P15.runRunning: [EN] The drill running now ({name}) is added here when it ends, never to real disruptions.
P15.exerciseNow: [EN] An exercise is running. Its figures go into the Exercise column only when it ends. Nothing on this screen changes what residents see.
P15.supLine: [EN] Shown as fewer than 5 so no household can be identified.
P15.demoRunName: [EN] Power outage exercise, Sample Towers A, B and C

reach.name: [EN] Reach by channel and language
reach.def: [EN] Share of households signed up for alerts that got at least one alert in a disruption. A household can be reached on more than one channel.

unreachable.name: [EN] Households not reachable digitally, and followed up
unreachable.def: [EN] Households on a check-in list with no phone or app, and how many an ambassador or partner then reached.

timeToAck.name: [EN] Time to first acknowledgement
timeToAck.def: [EN] Minutes from a disruption being logged to the first acknowledgement going out in every language.

stale.name: [EN] Alerts that went stale
stale.def: [EN] Alerts with no update within the period their playbook sets.

directory.name: [EN] Directory freshness and reports resolved
directory.def: [EN] Share of listings confirmed in the last 6 months, and reports of wrong details that were resolved.

rounds.name: [EN] Check-in rounds completed
rounds.def: [EN] Rounds where every household on the list was marked, out of rounds started.

everydayUse.name: [EN] Everyday use between disruptions
everydayUse.def: [EN] Visits to Find help, Map and Be ready outside any disruption. Counted as visits, not people.

smallNumber.name: [EN] Households still needing help when a disruption closed
smallNumber.def: [EN] Check-in households marked "Needs help" that were still open when the shared space closed.

trust.name: [EN] Trust and usefulness
trust.def: [EN] Asked of residents, ambassadors and partners in a short survey every quarter.

channels: [EN] Not counted: no way to know who read it
P15.trustWho: [EN] Asked in the resident app, by text message and at the Hub desk. Not inferred from behaviour.

P16.title: [EN] Look back and actions
P16.lead: [EN] Past disruptions and exercises, what happened more than once, and who is changing what because of it.
P16.reviewLine: [EN] Every quarter, with partner leads and the Community Experts Board. Not only after a major disruption.
P16.exerciseNow: [EN] An exercise is running. When it ends, its record appears here as a new exercise record. Actions you add now are kept as practice.
P16.gapsLead: [EN] Gaps that came up in more than one record. Each one needs an action with an owner.
P16.recordsLead: [EN] Records from closed shared spaces and from exercises, together.
P16.noneLine: [EN] Try another type, building or period.
P16.alsoRecurring: [EN] Also recorded here: {gap} (happened more than once)
P16.sessionRan: [EN] Ran for {t}. {n} practice actions recorded. Nothing reached residents.
P16.sessionOne: [EN] Ran for {t}. 1 practice action recorded. Nothing reached residents.
P16.sessionDebrief: [EN] Lessons are added at the debrief. The debrief record (story 3.8.3) is not in this prototype.
P16.sessionWhere: [EN] Sample Towers A, B and C
P16.running: [EN] Running now. Its record appears when it ends.
P16.demoRunName: [EN] Power outage exercise, Sample Towers A, B and C
P16.formNeed: [EN] Choose an owner role. A lesson without an owner is not an action.

suggest.Floors with no ambassador for check-ins: [EN] Recruit floor ambassadors for floors 11 and up in Sample Towers A and B, and agree a TNO phone round for any floor still without one.

P16.addedLine: [EN] It is in the actions list below and on the agenda for the review on {review}.
P16.addedToast: [EN] Action added with an owner and a due date.
P16.toPlaybook: [EN] Open the {hazard} playbook it will change
P16.addedPractice: [EN] Added during an exercise, as practice.
P16.actionsLead: [EN] {open} open, {done} done. Done actions link to what they changed.

bootstrap.incomplete: [EN] Finish setting up two Admins first
bootstrap.secondAdminOnly: [EN] Setup is not finished. You can add one more Admin now. Other people can be added once both Admins have their own password and authenticator.

people.title: [EN] Add a person
people.lead: [EN] Each person gets their own account. Nothing is sent to them: give them their username and starting password yourself.
people.usernameHint: [EN] People sign in with it. 3 to 32 characters: letters a to z and digits, with a single . _ or - between them.
people.nameHint: [EN] As written in Latin letters. The starting password is made from the first and last name.
people.emailHint: [EN] Kept as a contact detail. The Hub does not send email.
people.createdLine: [EN] Give them these in person. The starting password works once, within 24 hours. They choose their own password when they first sign in.

errors.usernameInvalid: [EN] Use 3 to 32 characters: letters a to z and digits, starting with a letter, with a single . _ or - between them.
errors.usernameTaken: [EN] That username is already taken. Choose another.
errors.nameTooLong: [EN] A name can have at most 100 characters.
errors.startingPasswordEmpty: [EN] The first and last name must each have a letter from a to z, because the starting password is made from them. Enter them as written in Latin letters.
errors.startingPasswordUnsupportedLetter: [EN] A name has a letter that cannot be written with a to z, so it cannot go into the starting password. Enter the name as written in Latin letters, using a plain a to z spelling for that letter.
errors.startingPasswordTooLong: [EN] The starting password would be longer than 72 characters. Shorten the name used for the password, for example the first given name and the first family name only.
errors.emailInvalid: [EN] Enter an email address, like name@example.org.
errors.adminExists: [EN] An Admin already exists. The first Admin can be created only once.
errors.forbidden: [EN] Only an Admin can add people.
errors.providerError: [EN] The account could not be created, and nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.providerRejected: [EN] Supabase rejected the starting password; check the project's password policy.
errors.passwordsNotConfigured: [EN] Staff passwords are not configured on this site (STAFF_PASSWORD_PEPPER), so no account can be created. Nothing was saved. Ask IT to set it.
errors.selfAction: [EN] You cannot change your own account. Ask another Admin.
errors.accountRemoved: [EN] This account was removed and cannot be changed.
errors.noChange: [EN] Nothing to change: the account is already like that.

signIn.title: [EN] Staff sign-in
signIn.lead: [EN] Sign in with the username and password you were given.
signIn.expired: [EN] Your starting password has expired or was already used. Ask an Admin for a new starting password.
signIn.unavailable: [EN] Sign-in is not working right now. Try again in a few minutes.

setup.incomplete: [EN] Finish setting up your account first.

password.title: [EN] Choose your password
password.lead: [EN] Your starting password works only this once. Choose a password that only you know.
password.passwordHint: [EN] At least 10 characters. It cannot contain your username or be your starting password.

errors.tooLong: [EN] This password is too long. Use at most 72 letters, or fewer if you use symbols or other alphabets.
errors.containsUsername: [EN] Your password cannot contain your username.
errors.isStartingPassword: [EN] Choose a password that is not your starting password.
errors.mismatch: [EN] The two passwords are not the same. Type the same password twice.
errors.rejected: [EN] That password was not accepted. Choose a different one.
errors.unavailable: [EN] Your password could not be saved. Nothing changed. Try again.
errors.notRequired: [EN] There is no starting password to replace. Sign in again.

authenticator.title: [EN] Set up your authenticator
authenticator.lead: [EN] Admins and Coordinators confirm each sign-in with a code from an authenticator app on their phone.
authenticator.install: [EN] First install an authenticator app on your phone, if you do not have one yet.
authenticator.scan: [EN] Scan this QR code with the authenticator app, or type the key into it.
authenticator.qrAlt: [EN] QR code for the authenticator app
authenticator.keyHint: [EN] This key is shown only now. If you leave this page, start again to get a new one.

reissue.title: [EN] Re-issue a starting password
reissue.lead: [EN] For someone whose starting password expired before they used it, or who signed in once without choosing their own password.
reissue.doneLine: [EN] Give it to them in person. It works once, within 24 hours.

errors.notReissuable: [EN] This person already chose their own password, or their account is suspended or removed.
errors.forbidden: [EN] Only an Admin can re-issue a starting password.
errors.providerError: [EN] The starting password could not be re-issued, and nothing changed. Try again.
errors.passwordsNotConfigured: [EN] Staff passwords are not configured on this site (STAFF_PASSWORD_PEPPER), so nothing was re-issued. Ask IT to set it.

admins.twoAdminRule: [EN] There must always be at least two usable Admins
admins.shortfallLine: [EN] Restore a second usable Admin: reset the password or authenticator of an Admin who cannot sign in, or give another person the Admin role. Until then, Admins cannot be suspended, removed or given another role.

resetPassword.title: [EN] Reset a password
resetPassword.lead: [EN] For someone who forgot their password. They get a new starting password and are signed out on every device.
resetPassword.doneLine: [EN] Give it to them in person. It works once, within 24 hours. They were signed out on every device.

compose.ackLead: [EN] The acknowledgement starts from suggested wording for the type and the place. Read it, change it if you need to, then submit it for a second person to approve.
compose.alertLead: [EN] Write what residents need to know now. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.benchmark: [EN] Aim: out within 5 to 10 minutes of the first report.
compose.textHint: [EN] At most {max} characters. It is translated into every launch language when you submit, and you cannot edit a translation.
compose.validResolved: [EN] Until resolved: 24 hours from now, renewed by each update
compose.validAt: [EN] Until a date and a time
compose.validHint: [EN] At most 7 days ahead. Staff enter it in Toronto time. You can change it with any update.

compose.preview911Last: [EN] The 911 line comes after the text.

compose.channelSms: [EN] Text messages: the exact texts are frozen when you submit. They go out once texting is live.

running.lead: [EN] Translating into every language and rendering the text messages. This takes up to {seconds} seconds. You can leave this page: it carries on, and what happened will be here when you come back.

result.fallback_en: [EN] Not translated: English with "Translation not available"

compose.updateLead: [EN] Add what we know now to this alert. Residents see it above the earlier entries, which stay as they are. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.promoteLead: [EN] This is the first update to the acknowledgement. The same alert is updated for everyone who has it: nothing is sent as a new alert. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.startNote: [EN] Saving makes the draft. Then you can change who it is for, read the text message and submit it for approval.

thread.title: [EN] The running alert
thread.lead: [EN] What residents read now, newest first. Your update is added at the top: nothing here is replaced.
thread.leadReplace: [EN] What residents read now, newest first. A correction is added above the entry it corrects. A withdrawal puts the reason in the place of the entry. Nothing is deleted.
thread.leadResolve: [EN] What residents read now, newest first. Your final entry is added at the top and closes the alert: nothing here is deleted.

compose.carried: [EN] Who it is for, the types and the languages are carried over from the alert. Change who it is for with the links below: the approver sees what changes.
compose.carriedStart: [EN] Who it is for, the types and the languages are carried over from the alert. Save the draft first, then change who it is for if you need to.
compose.sameAudience: [EN] Who it is for is the same as the alert now.
compose.phaseRequired: [EN] Required: choose where things stand now.
compose.updateClosed: [EN] This alert is already closed. Nothing more can be added to it.
compose.updateUnpublished: [EN] Nothing is published in this alert yet, so there is nothing to add an update to. Wait for its approval first.
compose.correctLead: [EN] A correction is added to the same alert in the open. The earlier wording stays readable, marked "Corrected", and residents see what changed. A second person approves it before anyone sees it.
compose.withdrawLead: [EN] Residents see "Withdrawn" and the reason in the place of the entry. A second person approves it before anyone sees it. If nothing else in the alert is left, the alert closes as withdrawn.
compose.targetsLead: [EN] These are the entries residents can read now. One that was corrected or withdrawn already is not here.
compose.targetsNone: [EN] No entry of this alert can be corrected or withdrawn now.
compose.withdrawWordsHint: [EN] Residents read the reason in the place of the entry, in their language. Add words of your own, or write the whole reason if you chose "Other". At most {max} characters.
compose.withdrawReasonHint: [EN] Residents see that the entry was withdrawn, with this reason.
compose.withdrawTextLabel: [EN] What residents read in the place of the entry
compose.withdrawTextHint: [EN] The reason, in English. It is translated into every language when you submit. At most {max} characters.
compose.withdrawCarried: [EN] Who it is for is who the withdrawn entry was for, and everyone who got that entry also gets this withdrawal.
compose.resolveLead: [EN] Resolving closes the alert with a final word. Nothing is deleted from residents' view: the alert moves to alerts that have ended with its whole thread. A second person approves the final message before anyone sees it.
compose.resolveTextHint: [EN] One or two short sentences: what is fixed, and what to do if it is not fixed for you. At most {max} characters.
compose.resolveStartNote: [EN] Saving makes the draft. Then you can read the text message and submit it for approval. Approving it closes the alert.
compose.resolveCarried: [EN] Who it is for is who the alert is for now. Everyone who got any entry of this alert also gets the final entry, on the channels they got it on.

after.title: [EN] What happens when you resolve
after.closes: [EN] The alert leaves the live list and moves to alerts that have ended. Opened from there, the final entry is on top and the thread below.
after.reach: [EN] Everyone who got any entry of this alert gets the final entry by text, on the channels they got it on.
after.stops: [EN] Nothing else is sent for this alert: texts still waiting for the other entries are cancelled, and drafts and entries waiting for approval are discarded.

approve.lead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will see and get. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.

approve.ambassadorBy: [EN] Written by a building ambassador. Residents see it as from a building ambassador.

approve.correctionLead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will see in place of the entry below. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.
approve.withdrawalLead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will read in the place of the entry below. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.
approve.replacesCorrection: [EN] Residents read this above the entry it corrects. The entry stays readable below it, marked "Corrected".
approve.replacesWithdrawal: [EN] Residents read "Withdrawn" and the reason in the place of this entry.
approve.reachesOriginal: [EN] This goes to everyone who got the original, and to everyone in the audience above.
approve.closesThread: [EN] Nothing else in this alert is left for residents to read. Approving it closes the alert as withdrawn: nothing more is sent for it, and its drafts and waiting entries are discarded.
approve.targetGone: [EN] The entry this replaces was corrected or withdrawn since it was written, so this cannot be approved. Discard it.
approve.finalLead: [EN] Read exactly what residents will read as the last word of this alert. You approve this version only. If it changes while you read, you review it again.
approve.closingReach: [EN] This goes to everyone who got any entry of this alert, on the channels they got it on, and to everyone in the audience above.
approve.closingCloses: [EN] Approving it closes the alert as resolved: nothing more is sent for it, and its drafts and waiting entries are discarded. Residents find it under alerts that have ended, with this message on top.

resetAuthenticator.title: [EN] Reset an authenticator
resetAuthenticator.lead: [EN] For a Coordinator or Admin who lost their phone. Their authenticator is removed and they are signed out on every device. They set up a new one the next time they sign in.
resetAuthenticator.doneLine: [EN] They were signed out on every device. At their next sign-in they set up a new authenticator.
resetAuthenticator.shortfall: [EN] This leaves fewer than two usable Admins. Restore a second usable Admin: reset the password or authenticator of an Admin who cannot sign in, or give another person the Admin role.
resetAuthenticator.providerNote: [EN] The old authenticator could not be deleted from the sign-in service just now. It no longer works here, and it is removed when they set up the new one.

providers.removedNote: [EN] No longer in the catalogue. It is unpublished and kept with its last-confirmed date, and cannot be published or confirmed.

directory.lead: [EN] Publishing sends every published provider to residents as one numbered release, in every language. A release is never changed afterwards: the next publish makes a new one.
directory.none: [EN] No release has been published yet. Residents see no directory until one is.
directory.publishHint: [EN] This takes a few seconds. Residents keep the current release until the new one is complete.
directory.done: [EN] Release {number} is now current. Providers: {providers}. Languages: {languages}.
directory.resumed: [EN] Files already stored when this publish continued: {files}.

directory.searchNone: [EN] This release has no search data, so search is not available to residents until a release has it.

texts.title: [EN] Pause or resume texts
texts.lead: [EN] One switch for every text that has not yet been handed to the provider. Use it to stop a mistake or a provider problem at once.
texts.running: [EN] Texts are going out as normal.
texts.whatPauseDoes: [EN] Pausing stops every text that has not yet been handed to the provider, alerts and texts to residents and to staff alike, except texts to on-call Admins. They wait in the queue and go out, in order, when you resume. A text that was already handed over cannot be called back.
texts.oncall: [EN] Texts to on-call Admins still go out during a pause, so a problem with sending is still reported.
texts.reasonHint: [EN] Everyone at the Hub sees this on every screen, with your name and the time. Up to 500 characters.
texts.resumeHint: [EN] Texts go out again in their usual order. Each one is checked once more just before it is handed over: texts of an alert that was corrected, withdrawn or closed in the meantime, or whose valid-until time has passed, are cancelled or skipped. A final alert, and the withdrawal that closed an alert, are still sent.

oncall.title: [EN] On-call numbers
oncall.lead: [EN] The Admins who get a text when sending is stuck or failing, so a problem is fixed before residents miss an alert. A text goes to every number on this list.
oncall.rule: [EN] Once texts are going out, no alert except a drill can be approved while this list is empty.
oncall.emptyConsequence: [EN] Add at least one before texts go live: until then no alert except a drill can be approved once texts are live.
oncall.hidden: [EN] Only the last four digits of a number are shown.

oncall.labelHint: [EN] For example "IT lead". Up to 40 characters. Shown only here.
oncall.numberHint: [EN] A Canadian number, for example 416-555-0123. It is stored for sending texts and shown here only as its last four digits.
